pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Irregular polygonal patches with soft, feathered pixel gradients at the boundaries. Patch area is significantly larger and more elongated on the upper flank, becoming progressively smaller and more rounded as they descend toward the visible portion of the foreleg.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Continuous network of light-colored negative space. The network exhibits variable pixel thickness, with the widest pathways occurring at junction nodes where three or more corridors intersect. The pathways maintain continuity across the entire visible flank surface.

other_distinctive_markers: Presence of a small avian organism (oxpecker) perched on the upper dorsal ridge, characterized by dark-colored pixels and a localized red focal point on the head region.
